images.title: 55 squared from a square of 60
images.purpose: Shows 55² as 3600 minus two 60 by 5 strips plus the 5 by 5 corner that was removed twice.
images.composition: One large square centred, with a strip down its right side and a strip along its bottom. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: A large square of side 60 with a dark outline; the label '60' centred above its top edge. Inside, a teal (#0072B2) 55 by 55 square in the top left corner, labelled '55' along its left side. A strip 5 wide down the full right side and a strip 5 tall along the full bottom, both with thin vermilion (#D55E00) diagonal hatching; each strip carries the label '− 300' placed just outside it with a short leader line. The 5 by 5 bottom right corner where the strips overlap is reddish purple (#CC79A7), labelled '+ 25' with a leader line. A small '5' marks the width of the right strip. Below the square, centred, the label '55² = 3025'. Exactly 1 teal square, 2 hatched strips, 1 corner square.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Cutting two strips removes the corner twice, so add 25 back once.
